faqs.q: When can bats be removed from a Occoquan attic?

Under our permit conditions the maternity season runs May 1 through August 15, and bats may not be excluded or removed then unless no young are present or there is a threat to human health or safety, so we inspect any time but schedule most Occoquan exclusions outside that window.
